headlines.title: Diamondback Energy (FANG) Stock May Look Rich Following Raised Dividend And Guidance
headlines.summary: Diamondback Energy has delivered a powerful run over the past few years, yet the recent pullback and busy deal activity leave a clear question for you as an investor. Is the current share price properly aligned with what the business is earning today and what those earnings could support over time? Over the past 5 years, the stock has gained 98.9%, which puts real pressure on the earnings story to justify how far the price has already come.

headlines.title: Five Point Infrastructure Announces Sale of Deep Blue Midland Basin to Diamondback Energy and KKR
headlines.summary: HOUSTON, November 10, 2026--Five Point Infrastructure LLC ("Five Point") today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its majority interest in Deep Blue Midland Basin LLC ("Deep Blue"), a produced-water infrastructure platform serving the Midland Basin, to Deep Blue’s current minority owner, Diamondback Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FANG) ("Diamondback"), and KKR, for cash consideration.

headlines.title: Diamondback Energy and KKR to Acquire Deep Blue Midland Basin from Five Point Infrastructure
headlines.summary: Strategic partnership to support Deep Blue's continued investment in full-cycle water infrastructure across West TexasMIDLAND and HOUSTON, Texas, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Diamondback Energy, Inc.

description: Diamondback Energy, Inc., an independent oil and natural gas company, acquires, develops, explores, and exploits unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin in West Texas, the United States. The company primarily focuses on the development of the Spraberry and Wolfcamp formations of the Midland Basin; and the Wolfcamp and Bone Spring formations of the Delaware Basin, both of which are part of the Permian Basin in West Texas and New Mexico. Diamondback Energy, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, Texas.
